meta.title: Migrate dashboard to rolldown-vite
meta.body_summary: Migrate the dashboard build tooling from Vite to rolldown-vite for improved build performance, claiming a ~10s production build time.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor migrated dashboard to rolldown-vite with narrative build time claim; Netlify deploy failed on staging, PR closed by author without human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1115 changed lines, this is a medium-sized build configuration change by absolute volume, concentrated in lockfile and config files. As a build tool migration perf PR it was closed—not merged—following a deploy failure on Netlify without any maintainer review.

review_details.concern_detail: Netlify deploy preview failed for dashboard-v2-novu-staging; PR was closed by the author without any human review or feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Migrate to rolldown-vite for improved build performance, claiming ~10s production build time.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by author after Netlify deploy failure; no maintainer review or comments.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Build tool migration in a monorepo requires successful CI deploy preview and possibly maintainer sign-off; the PR was closed after CI failure without any human interaction, illustrating that agent-submitted build changes can be abandoned if CI fails.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Netlify deploy failed, indicating a build problem; no human maintainer reviewed the PR.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides narrative build time (~10s) but no benchmark artifacts or comparison; deploy failure suggests reproducibility issues in staging environment.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix attempt after deploy failure.

core_change_summary.description: Migrate apps/dashboard build from Vite to rolldown-vite: update package.json pnpm overrides, switch to @vitejs/plugin-react-oxc, add cssMinify: 'esbuild' in vite config, and update lockfile.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Lockfile changes are 961 lines; a migration summary markdown was added then removed.
